Mike (Sales): Passing Novara Health to CS — short context below so we can move to onboarding. Private deployment (VPC), Okta SSO, target go-live 2026-05-15. During demo they saw intermittent long-tail inference latency on large prompts (20–30s), we promised p95 <3s for short prompts. This is a renewal-risk flag: 12mo contract, renewal conversation early Q1 2027 if perf doesn't stabilize. Tech contacts: Priya (priya@novara.health), Raj (infra). Asks: 1) ENG triage for latency + perf tuning 2) Support to validate SSO/SAML metadata and runbook 3) Enablement deck + ops runbook for their dev/ops teams. I'll attach demo logs and repro steps in thread. Thanks.

Sara (CS): Thanks Mike — I'll own the onboarding and run the kickoff. Owners: Sara = onboarding/PM, Josh = ENG latency triage, Elaine = SSO + support runbook, Mike = commercial follow-ups. Timeline: open ENG triage today, triage by EOW, kickoff Wed 2026-05-07. Mike — can you drop the demo logs and exact repro steps here?

Mike (Sales): dropping quick repro and truncated logs below.

```bash
# repro (from demo)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"open-13b-quant","input":"<long-doc>...<long-doc>\n\nQ: Summarize"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-xxxx"
# observed: 20-30s for prompts with ~8k tokens, p95 for short prompts (~50 tokens) is <3s
```

Mike (Sales): Note: customer asked about token cost expectations and dedicated capacity sizing. Priya prefers VPC peering for egress. :thumbsup:

- Sara: request logs + SP metadata, send calendar invite (today)
